profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
I am a game developer that has worked on game engine development, network programming, game AI, image processing, physics and rendering systems. 

Shipped titles:
Wizard of OZ Magic Match (Tech and Gameplay Programming)              - Android/iOS (Released 2017)
Crazy Cake Swap                 (Graphics and Gameplay Programming)      - Android/iOS    (Released 2016)
True Vegas Casino               (Gameplay Programming)                             - Android/iOS    (Released 2016)
God of War                          (Graphics Programming)                               - PS4               (Released 2018)

C++:           7 years (Knowledge of C++11)
Unity:       5 years
C#:             6 years
HLSL:        1 year
Java:         1 year
Python:     1 year

Game Engines: Unreal Engine 4, Unity 5.
API: DirectX11, OpenGL, STL.

Videos of my work:
•	Animation Blending: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v1c1o4rtfYA&feature=youtu.be
•	AI Pathfinding: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eqbYEUWKtX0&list=UU70DQ1orw-8o2hOdvBcOcIQ
•	Shadow Mapping: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uLkqzCcagMs
•	Ghost Manager, UDP and HUD Systems: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cnx5fQuYuXo
•	Anti-aliasing and Texture Mapping: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G4LuB3q-U6M
•	BEASF Image Enhancement (My algorithm): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KTzf6dl730E
